statements.t: With an experienced launch team and our NDA resubmission on track for later this year, we are well positioned to bring cytisinicline to people who want to quit, if it is approved.”

Resubmission of the New Drug Application (NDA) remains on track for the fourth quarter of 2026, and the Company anticipates potential FDA approval by the end of the second quarter of 2027, with U.S. commercial launch to follow, if approved.

The Company may not achieve its plans, projections, or other expectations and may not be able to successfully complete its NDA resubmission or obtain regulatory approval for cytisinicline on the anticipated timeline or at all.

risks.t: whether the Company generates stability data sufficient to support the NDA resubmission on the anticipated timeline
whether the resubmission adequately addresses the matters cited in the FDA’s complete response letter or the FDA requires additional data prior to approval
the outcome of any pre-approval inspection of Adare or other manufacturers and their ability to supply cytisinicline
the outcome of the Company’s dispute with Sopharma AD
the Company’s ability to raise additional capital as needed
the Company’s ability to successfully commercialize cytisinicline, if approved
